title: fix(app-shell): Studio's flow start node writes the api trigger the engine routes, and can set its secret (objectui#11054)
body:
Fixes #11054
Clause-②: no

Studio's flow start-node inspector could not author an inbound `api` flow. Its 「Webhook / API」 trigger wrote `triggerType: 'webhook'`, which `resolveFlowTriggerKind` (`@objectstack/spec/automation`) answers no trigger kind for, so the flow bound nothing. It also had no field for the per-flow secret the engine now requires on an `api` start node. Implemented along triage's direction (comment 5885217534).

## What changed

- **The select writes `api`.** The 「Webhook / API」 option's value is now `api`, the token the spec resolver routes. The Object and Entry condition fields that showed for the old token now show for `api`.
- **A `config.secret` field on the start node**, shown when the flow's trigger kind is `api`. The kind is asked of the whole draft with the spec's own `resolveFlowTriggerKind`, so a flow-level `type: 'api'` is covered as well as the select. The engine demands the secret in exactly those two cases, which the card names too. The gate is a new optional descriptor member, `flowKind`, ANDed with any `showWhen`. It keeps the stored-value re-show rule, so a secret held on a non-`api` start node stays on screen, flagged as retained.
- **Write-only**, through the metadata form's existing `secret` widget (`WIDGETS['secret']`, reused as-is, not a second widget):
  - a value already on the node is handed to the widget as its stored-state mask. It is never put into the input, never revealed, and it leaves the Advanced JSON block, because the field now owns the key;
  - leaving the control blank writes nothing, so the key stays absent. Blank never writes an empty string or the mask, either of which a server would store as the secret;
  - a save that never touched the control keeps the node's value. A node served without the key gains no key.
- **An authoring-time notice** while the flow is `api`-kind and the draft holds no non-blank secret. The emptiness test is the engine's own: whitespace-only still counts as missing. The notice clears once one is typed. It is shown, not blocking.

## Where it landed, and why beyond the claim's file surface

The claim named `flow-node-config.ts`. Rendering a new field kind and knowing the flow's kind need two more files:

- `FlowNodeConfigField.tsx` renders the `secret` kind and the notice;
- `FlowNodeInspector.tsx` resolves the flow kind from the draft, which the table cannot see.

The labels live where the inspector's existing labels live: the English strings are in the table, and the zh overlay is `FLOW_FIELD_ZH` in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`. None are in the ten locale packs, so this PR does not overlap with the pack edits in #11039.

## Measured before building

- **Census of stored `triggerType: 'webhook'`: zero.** Counted across this repo (all tracked files) and objectstack `origin/main` `0f6dcac5` (examples and seeds).
  - Control legs on the same pattern shape: 12 `record-*` hits here and 22 in objectstack examples. The showcase's `triggerType: 'api'` inbound flow is hit too.
  - Per the ruling, no load-time normalisation was added. A stored `webhook` from a real deployment renders as the select's flagged unknown value, which the author re-picks.
- **The served flow carries no signal that a secret is stored.** objectstack-ai/objectstack#20552 landed as objectstack-ai/objectstack PR 20585: `redactFlowCredentials` drops `config.secret` from every served definition read. `metadata-redaction.ts` ("Why nothing is stamped on the wire") puts no marker beside it, and the read decorations list holds only `_diagnostics` and `_draft`. The write-path carry-forward keeps the stored secret when the body carries no key.
  - What this means here: the inspector can show that a secret is set only when the draft carries one. That is a value typed in this session, or one served by a server that predates the projection.
  - For a served node without the key, a stored secret and no secret look the same. So the notice is worded to be true either way: no secret was entered, the flow is refused without one, and one already saved is kept when this is left blank.
  - Making it exact would need a served marker. That is an objectstack contract decision, raised in the report and not made here.

## Pins

- `flow-node-config.apiTrigger-11054.test.ts`, the table half:
  - the option's value resolves to `api` through the real resolver;
  - the retired token resolves to nothing, and no option writes it;
  - the zh overlay covers the new value;
  - the secret field's gate, checked against the resolver for both spellings, for other kinds, for the schedule-precedence case and for a host that supplies no kind;
  - retained flagging;
  - the notice predicate.
- `FlowNodeInspector.apiTriggerSecret-11054.test.tsx`, what the author sees:
  - choosing the option commits `api`;
  - the field appears only for an `api`-kind flow;
  - a held value is never rendered, revealed or echoed;
  - an untouched save keeps it, and a node served without the key gains none;
  - erasing a typed value goes back to the held one;
  - blank writes no key and never the mask;
  - Clear drops the held value;
  - read-only writes nothing;
  - the notice appears, clears, and stays up for whitespace-only.

**Ablation**, four legs, run once after committing the fix. Each leg planted one literal mutation through `ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor had to hit exactly once), ran both files, and restored. The restore was proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`:

| Leg | Mutation | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | option value back to `webhook` | 4 red (3 table, 1 render), 25 green |
| B | the held value passed to the widget instead of the mask | 2 red (never-rendered; Clear), 27 green |
| C | the `flowKind` gate removed | 5 red (hidden-for-other-kinds, table and render; no-kind host; retained flag), 24 green |
| D | notice render removed | 3 red (notice pins), 26 green |

## Gates

Final HEAD `fc09cfb29`. Its last commit adds only the changeset; the source bytes are the same as `c8d3e0a94`.

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`: Test Files 335 passed (335), Tests 4037 passed and 1 skipped (4038), at HEAD `fc09cfb29`.
- Both new files: 29 passed (29).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test config includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`): exit 0. It ran after building the dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`, 28/28 tasks).
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 6 changed TS files: exit 0, 0 errors, 3 warnings. All 3 are the same 3 the `480de81fd` blob of `FlowNodeInspector.tsx` carries, shifted by the lines added above them.
  - Narrowing: the population is the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` blocks. The file count is 6, read from `--format json`. No block enables type-aware linting and no local rule reads the disk, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` exit 0.
- `check:` new-line-citations, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-dead-keys, i18n-designer-parity, vi-mock-specifiers, vi-mock-inherit, vi-mock-override-shape, test-path-roots, changeset-claims, pending-changeset-literals, unreferenced-sources, spec-symbols, phantom-deps, designer-field-key-parity, comment-mask-corpus: all exit 0.
  - `changeset-claims` named 5 pending changesets that mention a touched file. I read each paragraph, and none is made false by this diff.

## Acceptance notes

- **Clear, on a server that withholds the secret.** An absent key means "keep the stored secret" there, so Clear only discards a value held in the draft. Studio cannot remove a stored secret on such a server. That follows from the read contract above, not from this change.
- **`hookId`.** It is another start-node key an `api` flow reads, defaulting to `default`. It still lives in the Advanced JSON block; no field was added for it.
